request.spec:
A person should be able to have more than one patron, not just one. Show all of a person's
patrons by name. Backing should now be the total of all their patrons' thrust added together,
and net stays as momentum plus backing.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for this implementation's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A person should be able to have more than one patron, not just one. Show all of a person's
patrons by name. Backing should now be the total of all their patrons' thrust added together,
and net stays as momentum plus backing.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
A person can now have any number of patrons. `bin/e2e` passes: both acceptance tests pass, and so does the replay of earlier checkpoints' test data. The test only checks what's displayed. I did not try the new way of choosing patrons on a row (the UI or the API call behind it).

**Stored data:** a new migration, `V5__person_patrons.sql`, adds a `person_patron` table linking each person to their patrons. Anyone who already had a single patron keeps them as their first entry. The old `patron_id` column is removed.

**Server:**
- `Person` now holds a set of patrons, listed in name order.
- Backing is the total of all the patrons' thrust. It stays `n/a` when someone has no patrons, and also when any patron's thrust is missing (same as before with a single patron).
- Net is still momentum plus backing, counting backing as zero when there are no patrons.
- The people API now returns `patrons: [{id, name}]` in place of `patronId` and `patronName`.
- The update call now takes a list, `patronIds: [...]`, which replaces all of a person's patrons at once. It still refuses a person as their own patron and refuses unknown ids.
- The test seed accepts a `patrons` list of `{personId, patronId}` and reads it back under the same key. It refuses any other field with a 400, and reset clears the new table.

**Front end:** the Patrons cell lists every patron's name, sorted and separated by commas. The patron dropdown on each row is now a multi-select and keeps its `person-patron-select` test id. Changing the selection saves the whole set of patrons.

Seed data can no longer put a `patronId` on a person; patrons must come through the `patrons` list. The test spec says that field is gone, and none of the earlier test data that gets replayed uses it.
